title: SPCX Stock Jumps Overnight: Cursor Deal Pushes SpaceX Deeper Into 'Most Expensive' Territory, Morningstar Says
title_zh: SPCX 股价一夜暴涨：晨星称 Cursor 交易将 SpaceX 推向“最昂贵”领域
summary: Morningstar cut its fair value estimate to $62 from $63 after the Cursor acquisition, implying a 69% downside from current levels.
summary_zh: 收购 Cursor 后，晨星将其公允价值预估从 63 美元下调至 62 美元，这意味着较当前水平下降 69%。

title: MSFT Falls 2% On Tuesday — Microsoft Reportedly Walks Away From $3B Oracle Cloud Deal
title_zh: MSFT 周二下跌 2%——据报道微软放弃了 30 亿美元的 Oracle 云交易
summary: Microsoft has reportedly abandoned talks with Oracle to lease $3 billion in AI computing power after a stalemate over federal security regulations.
summary_zh: 据报道，在联邦安全法规陷入僵局后，微软放弃了与甲骨文租赁 30 亿美元人工智能计算能力的谈判。

title: House and Senate Leaders Reach Deal on Housing Bill
title_zh: 众议院和参议院领导人就住房法案达成协议
summary: The so-called 21st Century Road to Housing Act is a bipartisan effort to increase home affordability.
summary_zh: 所谓的“21世纪住房之路法案”是两党共同努力提高住房负担能力的成果。

title: SpaceX Bolsters AI Business With $60 Bil Deal. Musk Targets $1 Tril In Revenue.
title_zh: SpaceX 以 600 亿美元的交易支持人工智能业务。马斯克的收入目标是 1 特里尔。
summary: SpaceX boosts AI business with $60 billion deal for Cursor. Elon Musk makes this bold revenue target. SPCX stock surges.
summary_zh: SpaceX 以 600 亿美元收购 Cursor，推动人工智能业务发展。埃隆·马斯克制定了这个大胆的收入目标。 SPCX 股价飙升。

title: Oil Falls to Three-Month Low as US-Iran Deal Set to Add Supply
title_zh: 美伊协议将增加供应，油价跌至三个月低点
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Oil logged its longest run of declines this year as the US-Iran deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz boosted expectations for a revival in supply, with leading Wall Street banks reducing their price forecasts and key market gauges tumbling.Most Read from Bloomber...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——由于美伊重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的协议提振了供应复苏的预期，华尔街主要银行降低了价格预测，主要市场指标暴跌，油价录得今年最长的连续下跌。
